data.title: 爱宕 · 晨曦厨房的围裙甜羹试尝
data.description: 早晨温馨明亮的厨房内，锅中炖着香气四溢的日式高汤。爱宕系着可爱的棉麻围裙，内穿贴身无袖针织，长黑发挽成温柔的侧马尾。她手持木勺尝过汤汁后，转过身来微笑着将勺子轻轻吹凉递向前方。犬耳随心跳欢快摇晃，眼眸中盛满了宛如温柔娇妻般无尽的宠爱。
data.action: standing in sunlit kitchen holding tasting wooden spoon forward, domestic apron over knit top, black dog ears perked happily, hair in side ponytail, sweet loving smile
data.location: bright airy modern kitchen with warm wooden countertops
data.lighting: cheerful morning sunbeams illuminating kitchen steam and glossy hair
data.mood: heart-melting domestic romance, perfect wife pampering
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit kitchen with steam rising from a soup pot, Atago holds forward a tasting spoon with an apron over her knit top. Her black dog ears perk cheerfully as she offers an adoring, wifely smile.
data.animaCaption: Atago offering a tasting spoon in an apron in a sunny kitchen, dog ears perking happily.
